papers.working_title: Machine Epistemics: Toward an Absorptive Science of AI-Driven Inquiry

claims.claim: Machine-mediated research creates cross-parent scientific-state transition failures not captured by evaluating isolated model outputs.
claims.hard_falsifier: All protected failures are fully and more simply handled by F0 native parents and ordinary workflow engineering.

claims.claim: F2 can preserve parent-native validity while generating or improving decisions beyond the strongest parent federation.
claims.hard_falsifier: F0, F1 or F3 matches or exceeds F2 under matched information and resources.

claims.claim: Machine-native internal computation is compatible with scientific accountability through claim-sufficient external witnesses.
claims.hard_falsifier: External witnesses either fail to preserve scientific validity or impose costs that erase machine-native gains.

papers.working_title: Structural Donor Discovery and Conservative Scientific Generalization

claims.claim: Typed structural donor search improves remote-parent recovery beyond strongest retrieval, analogy, LBD and expert controls.
claims.hard_falsifier: Gain disappears under strongest union or matched expert/search effort.

claims.claim: Decision-preserving reduction prevents false analogy and improves novelty contraction.
claims.hard_falsifier: MDL/sufficiency/native parent methods preserve the same decisions more simply.

claims.claim: Scientific transport requires typed, context-relative relation families rather than one universal similarity measure.
claims.hard_falsifier: A simpler universal or strongest parent metric reproduces all protected decisions.

claims.claim: Conservative composition and selective reopening preserve valid prior judgments under relation and evaluator changes.
claims.hard_falsifier: Parent-specific composition and revalidation recover the same outcomes without an integrated relation layer.

papers.working_title: Obligation-Driven Scientific Problem Solving with Witnessed Escalation

claims.claim: Explicit scientific state, obligations and calibrated minimum escalation improve justified terminals beyond strongest adaptive parent solvers.
claims.hard_falsifier: F0 or a simple controller matches the protected quality-cost frontier.

claims.claim: Typed exploratory and constructive action prevents hypothesis-space lock-in without producing uncontrolled exploration cost.
claims.hard_falsifier: Active-learning/open-ended parents obtain the same gain or typed exploration causes unacceptable drag.

claims.claim: Component activation can be calibrated so framework structure remains inactive on simple cases and resilient under disturbance.
claims.hard_falsifier: Added structure increases latency/failure surface without preventing critical errors.

papers.working_title: Dependence-Aware Scientific Evidence and Dynamic Evaluation

claims.claim: Support-family and dependence modelling reduces false corroboration while preserving genuine independent support.
claims.hard_falsifier: Standard dependence modelling plus provenance produces identical decisions.

claims.claim: Argument, test/oracle adequacy and criticism uptake improve assurance beyond vote count or provenance-only review.
claims.hard_falsifier: The mature assurance/argumentation product reproduces outcomes or the integrated method adds inconsistency.

claims.claim: Dynamic evaluator and authority modelling prevents static passes from being transported after strategic or environmental response.
claims.hard_falsifier: Static evaluation plus existing performativity/security parents is sufficient.

papers.working_title: Before the Hypothesis: Prospective Scientific Opportunity Discovery

claims.claim: Typed source-bound opportunity records produce prospectively useful research actions beyond experts and strongest parent methods.
claims.hard_falsifier: No prospective incremental value or result depends on hindsight.

claims.claim: Substrate-relative machine representations or search policies can causally improve protected scientific transitions beyond human-mimetic, strongest-parent and hybrid systems.
claims.hard_falsifier: Advantage is explained by compute, leakage, opacity, weak baselines or disappears in a second domain.

papers.working_title: Scientific Warrant Factorization for Machine-Mediated Inquiry

claims.claim: The warranted scope of a scientific transition is bounded by the weakest necessary warrant link across source, semantics, model, computation, oracle/test, argument, dependence, transport and authority.
claims.hard_falsifier: The proposition is only a restatement of mature assurance products or adds no protected decision.

papers.admission_rule: Admit only after a distinct theorem or protected cross-domain residual not cleanly carried by P-D/flagship.
